cover.desc: Full color, warm gold, and it should look like a good night — because it is one. The bath hall of Kotobuki-yu seen from high in the corner, full: thirty or so people, shoulders-up in heavy steam that fills the lower half of the frame, the chipped Mt. Fuji mural lit warm behind them, condensation running down the tiles. Old men talking, two of them arguing about something trivial, a small boy being held up to look at the mural, somebody laughing with their head back. Not one face in the crowd is sad. Steam and gold and wet tile. Small in the doorway at the bottom edge of the frame, half in and half out, with an armful of towels and her hair clipped up: Nagi, in motion, not looking at any of it. The only person in the picture who knows what date it is is the one who isn't in the room.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: striking the pressure gauge once, cleanly, with the wrench

panels.bg: the boiler room at 5:40pm, bare bulb, the gauge, the worn mark in the paint beside the nail
panels.action: Thirty-first of March. Once. The way he did it. The needle drops straight into the green.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, absorbed, doing it exactly right
chars.pose: crouched at the burner, hand on the ignition

panels.bg: boiler room, burner window catching orange, bare bulb
panels.action: She lights it. She has done this five hundred and eighty-two times.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: one hand on the temperature dial, turning it two marks past where it lives

panels.bg: the dial, bare bulb, the boiler casing
panels.action: Two degrees hotter than any night in fourteen months. Nobody is going to be told about this. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: reaching up, ordinary
chars.pose: hanging the indigo noren on its hooks from outside

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance at 5:58pm, the last of the daylight, the shotengai behind her
panels.action: Second time in thirteen chapters the reader has watched this go up.

panels.bg: the street outside seen from the doorway: about forty people already waiting, in coats, with towels under their arms, chatting — not a crowd so much as a full house. Two of the shuttered shops have handwritten notices taped inside the glass.
panels.action: They came early. Nobody is making a fuss. Silent.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: planted in the genkan with the clipboard and the numbered wooden tags, exactly as before
chars.pose: hand out for the first pair of shoes

panels.bg: the genkan, sandal rack, warm lamp
panels.action: He turned up at half past five and said nothing to anybody about why.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: moving, unreadable, entirely on top of it
chars.pose: crossing the room with baskets, taking money, answering two people at once

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: at the towel table, working

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: carrying a crate, shouting something cheerful

panels.bg: the changing room at 6:40pm — a proper full house, sixty-odd people, steam, coats, baskets, noise, the fish clock, the massage chair going
panels.action: It is not a hundred and forty. It is sixty, and it is much heavier.

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: towel on his head, arguing with total conviction

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: arguing back, equally certain

panels.bg: the bath hall, heavy steam across the lower two-thirds, mural behind, shoulders-up framing only
panels.action: It is two degrees hotter and neither of them can prove it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: passing the doorway with an armful of towels, not stopping, not reacting

panels.bg: the bath doorway, steam, the argument continuing off-panel
panels.action: She hears all of it and keeps walking. Silent.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: in an apron, ladling something from a pot by the door, entirely at home

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: going past at speed with two crates

panels.bg: the changing room, the crowd, warm lamp, steam
panels.action: Nobody organised any of this. People simply turned up with things.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: not looking up, holding a bottle of water out sideways at exactly the right height

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: taking it without breaking stride

panels.bg: towel table, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: Ban's towels, Aya's rice, Nagi's milk, and now this. Nobody on this street has ever asked anybody if they need anything.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — in motion, one of a dozen bodies
chars.pose: somewhere in the middle of it

panels.bg: the whole changing room from the ceiling corner at 8pm, packed and orderly — baskets stacked correctly, the towel line moving, the genkan under control, not one thing out of place
panels.action: It is, by a distance, the best-run night in the building's history. She has not stopped moving since twenty to six.

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: elderly, dressed again, hair damp, entirely matter-of-fact
chars.pose: at the counter paying, coin purse open

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, making change

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, the crowd behind him
panels.action: He is not being sentimental. He has a genuine scheduling problem.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely level, giving him the only thing she has

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Logistics. It is all she has ever had to give anybody and tonight it is not enough for anything.

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: thinking about it, working out a route, not upset

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not moving

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, crowd noise all round them
panels.action: Nobody's feelings are mentioned. Nobody's feelings need to be.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already gone, carrying baskets

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: heading for the door, tag in hand

panels.bg: the changing room, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: Four seconds later she is doing something else. Silent.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: watching her cross the room for the fortieth time, saying nothing about it

panels.bg: the door end of the changing room, steam, crowd
panels.action: Five hours. She has not sat down, she has not eaten, and she has not slowed by one step. Silent.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: deciding, correctly, to leave her alone

panels.bg: the pot, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: Working is the only thing holding the evening together and Aya has worked that out. Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: deep in the chair, eyes shut, exactly as she is every single night

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: on the arm of the chair, legs swinging, mid-report

panels.bg: the rest area, the massage chair going, crowd all round, warm lamp
panels.action: He is telling her about a dog. It has eleven parts.

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: on the tatami with three others, arguing about baseball

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: shaking his head

panels.bg: rest area, crowd, warm lamp, steam through the doorway
panels.action: Six people are having an argument about a relief pitcher. It gets quite heated.

panels.bg: the rest area at 9:15pm — every inch of the tatami taken, kids on the floor, bottles, a radio on somewhere, damp hair, coats piled up, the fish clock four minutes fast on the wall above all of it
panels.action: Nobody in this room is talking about the building. That is what they came to do. Silent.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: arriving at the counter with a paper bag, entirely unceremonious

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: hands full

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, crowd
panels.action: He has been told the grammar by somebody. He gets it exactly right.

dialogue.text: They gave me too many. Croquettes.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking at the bag, and then at him

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Ban's towels. Aya's rice. Mio's water. Somebody has taught this boy the only sentence anyone on this street will accept. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: sleeves soaked, coming up the boiler steps, filthy and calm

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: meeting him at the top

panels.bg: the boiler steps and the changing room, steam, crowd noise
panels.action: Two numbers, at speed, as they pass each other.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopped at the counter, both hands flat on it, eyes bright and absolutely still

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, the crowd out of focus behind, noise
panels.action: Four seconds. She is not crying. Her eyes are just wet, the way eyes get. Silent.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: arriving at counter height, looking up, diagnosing a practical problem
chars.pose: both hands on the counter ledge

panels.bg: the counter from below, warm lamp, crowd
panels.action: To a six-year-old, wet eyes mean one thing and one thing only, and there is a known fix for it. Silent.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: n/a — hand only, small, entirely serious
chars.pose: a small palm laid flat across her forehead as a visor, two fingers tapping twice on her hairline

panels.bg: close, warm lamp, her hair, blurred noise behind. ART NOTE: compose to match Ch.5 page 10 panel 2 exactly — same crop, same hand position, same two taps. The hand is smaller and the forehead is bigger.
panels.action: Grandfather, to her, to him. Nobody has ever sent it the other way. The reader will recognise this a full panel before she does.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes closing on the second tap, automatically, before she has decided anything
chars.pose: head tipped very slightly back under a small hand

panels.bg: warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Her body obeys it. It was always going to. Silent.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: satisfied, already turning away, work concluded

panels.bg: the counter, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: He is not asking. He has decided.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: opening her eyes to nobody there

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, an empty patch of floor where a six-year-old was
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: eyes open for once, having watched the whole thing from the chair
chars.pose: milk bottle in both hands, not moving

panels.bg: the massage chair across the room, crowd between them, warm lamp
panels.action: One person in this building knows exactly what she just watched, and she is not going to mention it, tonight or ever. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: picking up a stack of baskets and going

panels.bg: the packed changing room, warm lamp, steam, sixty people
panels.action: Eleven seconds. Then she goes back to work. Silent.

panels.bg: the changing room at 10:30pm, thinning out — half the baskets empty, coats gone from the pile, the genkan clearing, three pairs of shoes left in a rack built for forty
panels.action: The tide goes out slowly and then all at once. Silent.

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: at the counter, wanting to say something and finding nothing available

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, the emptying room
panels.action: He opens his mouth twice. Nothing that exists is the right size.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: handing back the second-to-last tag, clipboard under his arm, not looking up

panels.bg: the genkan, two pairs of shoes, warm lamp, cold night beyond the glass
panels.action: He has stood in that doorway for five and a half hours. He does not say goodbye to anybody, including her. Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: getting out of the chair the way she does every night, one hand on the arm

panels.bg: the rest area at 10:51pm, nearly empty, the chair still running, warm lamp
panels.action: 10:51. She leaves at ten to eleven. She has left at ten to eleven for sixty-two years.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: crossing to the crate and putting her own empty bottle into it
chars.pose: bending, setting it down among the others

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: watching her do it

panels.bg: the bottle crate by the cold case, warm lamp, the empty room
panels.action: For fourteen months Nagi has cleared that bottle away for her. It is the only thing Fusae-san does differently tonight, and it is enormous, and neither of them acknowledges it. Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: cheerful, at the noren, raising one hand — exactly as always

panels.bg: the noren, cold night beyond, warm light behind her
panels.action: The same two words she has said every night. She does not mark it. That is the whole of it.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: coat on, Sōta asleep against her hip, waiting by the door

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: shouldering a bag, quiet for once

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: apron folded over her arm

panels.bg: the genkan at 11:20pm, empty racks, warm lamp, the street dark outside
panels.action: Nobody offers to stay. All three of them worked it out separately and got it right. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: reaching up, ordinary

panels.bg: the empty changing room, the fish clock at 11:34, baskets stacked, the massage chair still humming to itself
panels.action: 11:30. The sign. Same as every night. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, crouched at the far end
chars.pose: reaching into the water for the plug chain

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small, in the doorway

panels.bg: the empty bath hall, full and steaming, the chipped Fuji mural, one lamp, nobody in the water
panels.action: She pulls the plug. It takes about forty minutes to empty.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: sitting against the tiled wall, wrecked, hands loose
chars.pose: on the tile edge, legs out, watching the level go down

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: a metre along the same wall, same posture

panels.bg: the bath hall, the water two-thirds down and going, steam thinning, one lamp, the drain sound filling the room
panels.action: The only sound in the building is a bath emptying. This is where it happens.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not looking at her, saying it to the water

panels.bg: the emptying bath, tile, thinning steam
panels.action: He has been carrying this since the thirty-first was said out loud. It comes out as two words about a rota.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes on the falling water line

panels.bg: the tile and the water line, steam, lamp
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, stating a fact, testing it

panels.bg: tile, water line lower, thinning steam
panels.action: She does not argue with him. She hands him a problem.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes forward, no performance anywhere on him, offering the only thing he has ever had

panels.bg: the emptying bath, tile, one lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Nobody in this series can say a feeling out loud. He offers her a household in the shape of a chore, and the word he uses is the one his brother used in chapter five.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, against the wall

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small, against the wall

panels.bg: the bath hall from the far end, the water down to the last foot, steam almost gone, the mural dry above the line, two small figures against a long tiled wall
panels.action: A very long time. Neither of them moves and the water keeps going down. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, eyes forward, giving permission in the only grammar she owns
chars.pose: hands flat on the tile either side of her

panels.bg: tile, the last of the water, one lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Four words. She said the first two of them about a dead man's sandals in chapter six, and she is saying them now about the rest of her life.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: face doing something enormous and completely undramatic, eyes still forward
chars.pose: not turning to look at her

panels.bg: tile, empty bath below the frame, one lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: He does not turn round and he does not say anything and he does not touch her. Silent.

panels.bg: the drain, the last of the water going round it, then nothing — wet tile, a chain, a dry rim
panels.action: Empty.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: getting up, businesslike, entirely composed
chars.pose: standing, reaching for the small brush

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: getting up with her

panels.bg: the empty tub, tile, one lamp
panels.action: And then they clean it, because it still needs cleaning. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absorbed, working the grout line she has worked every night for fourteen months
chars.pose: on hands and knees on the floor

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: two metres off, blue brush, angle correct

panels.bg: the bath hall, no steam now, the empty tub, one lamp, the tile grid running away — compose to echo Ch.3 page 5 and Ch.12 page 15
panels.action: The last time. It takes forty minutes and they do it properly.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: concentrating on a small thing
chars.pose: sliding the small brush into the red bucket handle-up, the way she keeps them

panels.bg: the red bucket, wet tile, three brushes standing in it
panels.action: Handle-up. He learned that in chapter three by watching without either of them noticing.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reaching up and taking it down, and not explaining himself
chars.pose: lifting the blue-handled brush off its own hook on the tiled wall and putting it into his school bag

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: watching him do it, saying nothing

panels.bg: the corner of the bath hall, the shelf, the hook now empty, the red bucket below
panels.action: She hung that on that hook in chapter four so there would be an object that only made sense if there were two people. It does not belong to this building. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reaching, unremarkable, competent
chars.pose: unhooking the indigo noren from outside and folding it in three movements without looking at his hands

panels.bg: the Kotobuki-yu entrance at 1:04am, cold clear night, sign dark, the shuttered street
panels.action: He folds it correctly. He has done since chapter four.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her hand on the boiler shutdown valve, closing it all the way round

panels.bg: boiler room, the valve, bare bulb, the gauge starting to fall. ART NOTE: fourth and final time we compose this exact crop — Ch.9 p17 (hand off), Ch.10 p8 (turned), Ch.12 p14 (off the casing).
panels.action: Fifteen years and one hundred and eighty-two days without going out. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: reaching behind the vinyl for the switch on the side panel

panels.bg: the rest area, the massage chair, warm lamp, the empty tatami
panels.action: It ran for eighteen years unplugged and forty-one days awake. He switched it off once, in chapter eight, as a kindness. She does it now, and the building goes completely silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up, an instruction like any other
chars.pose: at the counter with the ledger

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: already turning for the steps

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, the silent building
panels.action: Two words. She is handing over a fifteen-year record and she does it the way she asks for a brush.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: thumb stopped on a page he has seen once before
chars.pose: the exercise book open on one forearm

panels.bg: the open logbook — the page where the small neat slanted hand ends and a larger, rounder, unsteadier one starts the very next day with no gap. ART NOTE: handwriting shapes only, no legible characters.
panels.action: He found this page in chapter six and made the worst joke of his life over it. He does not stop for long. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: reading the gauge one last time, level
chars.pose: at the top of the boiler steps

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: pencil out, book flat on the counter

panels.bg: the counter and the boiler doorway, warm lamp, the silent building
panels.action: Numbers, at each other, in an empty building. The last two either of them will ever say in this room.

panels.bg: the last used page of the logbook under the lamp: a column of the larger rounder hand running down it, and on the final ruled line, directly under the last of hers with no gap at all, one entry in a terrible loose scrawl. ART NOTE: handwriting shapes only, no legible characters. Three hands have written in this book. None of them left a blank line.
panels.action: Fifteen years, three people, one column. Final entry. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — crouched, back turned, doing something at the bath doorway
chars.pose: dipping one hand into the last bucket and flicking the water across the entrance stone

panels.bg: the bath doorway of a completely silent, completely dry building, one lamp, the wet patch spreading on the stone
panels.action: There has been no water on that stone for an hour. He is doing this on purpose. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — back turned, hand stopping flat on the counter
chars.pose: at the bandai with her back to the room

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, and forty feet behind her one footstep on wet stone
panels.action: Chapter six. Chapter ten. She does not turn round, and she does not need to, and the building has nothing to do with it. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: a key in her hand, the folded noren under one arm, face level
chars.pose: on the step, having just locked the door

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: waiting on the pavement, bag on his shoulder

panels.bg: the dark entrance of Kotobuki-yu at 1:52am, the lamp off, the hooks above the doorway empty, cold clear night
panels.action: One word each. It has meant the same thing since chapter six and it does not stop meaning it tonight.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, back turned, walking
chars.pose: up the middle of the street, noren under her arm

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small, back turned, walking beside her

panels.bg: ART NOTE: third and final composition of Chapter 1 page 1 — same angle, same crop, same distance. The shuttered shopping street at night, the tiled bathhouse facade. The differences: the chimney is venting nothing at all, the lamp over the entrance is dark, the hooks above the doorway are empty, and two small figures are walking away from it up the middle of the road. No narration box, no dialogue, no sound effect.
panels.action: Final panel. Everything in the frame is over and there are two people in it.
